description: Collapse-safety invariants defining lawful pre-collapse behavior, collapse entry conditions, and recovery constraints across DSLO substrates.

pre_collapse_stability.definition: Substrates must maintain lawful curvature stability until collapse thresholds are reached.

lawful_collapse_entry.definition: Collapse must occur only when lawful thresholds are exceeded under DSLO geometry.

bounded_collapse_behavior.definition: Collapse behavior must remain within lawful bounds and avoid illegal divergence.

recovery_basin_requirement.definition: Recovery must occur within a lawful attractor basin that restores curvature stability.

cross_surface_collapse_consistency.definition: Collapse and recovery behavior must remain consistent across all DSLO surfaces.

notes.lawfulness: Collapse-safety invariants ensure lawful substrate behavior before, during, and after collapse.
notes.integration: Collapse-safety invariants bind directly to geometry primitives, transitions, surfaces, and examples within the v0.7 release cluster.
notes.cross_domain: Collapse-safety invariants apply uniformly across biological, cultural, abstract, physical, and machine-facing substrates.
